evidence_to_design_mapping.design_use: Measure and model local growth-plate state plus systemic endocrine features rather than age alone.
Pre-register estrogen-related puberty variables as predictive inputs in participants of every sex.
Treat resting-zone depletion as an animal-supported mechanistic rationale; do not estimate it as a human causal mediator.
Use repeated observations and interval-censored closure outcomes, not a single age cutoff.
Add inherited variation only as controlled exploratory or predictive features with ancestry-aware evaluation.
